The Red Devils' 71% win probability in our model underscores their technical superiority and greater tournament experience, though Egypt's recent competitive form suggests they won't be pushovers in what should be a tactically intriguing opener. Belgium's depth of talent across all positions gives them multiple pathways to control this fixture, making an Egyptian upset highly unlikely barring a disciplined defensive performance and clinical finishing on the counter.
